authority: #K2-371 sec.3: the current blockage is a PLANNING-LAYER missing drawing (sec.16). This is the required regression artifact (sec.16.3 four elements) and it MUST carry a binary verdict.

scenario_frozen.note: #K2-371 sec.2: the frame correction is ratified and the scenario (members / frame / delta) is FROZEN. Nothing here changes it.

verdict_plain: the frozen scenario cannot be satisfied by ANY rigid translation of the block: the placement gate admits exactly ONE lattice point (3.5,3.5) and that point makes the moved copper overlap fixed foreign copper. This is a PLANNING defect (how the frame/delta are chosen), not a routing-capability defect.

baseline_geometric_digest.rule: #K2-371 sec.5: byte SHA is not a criterion; this canonical geometric digest is. Same board, two computations -> identical.

element_1_cause_of_death: After a rigid translation the moved block copper sweeps into the band R+delta\R, where the OUTSIDE (fixed) copper and the fixed dR ports live. A rigid motion therefore drives moved copper into fixed foreign copper for every gate-legal delta.

element_2_proven_facts.claim: at the frozen delta the moved set overlaps fixed foreign copper

reading.example: moved PERSTA# copper at (46.95,38.25) touches fixed MCU_VDD copper (dist 0.0000mm)
reading.also: a moved GND pad (U5/2) lands on the I2C2_SCL dR port - the same conflict, seen as a pad-on-port

element_2_proven_facts.claim: EVERY SE lattice point (the rule-derived direction) conflicts
the PLACEMENT gate admits exactly one of those 8 points, and it is the conflicting one
wider scan: only NW (-X,-Y) translations are ever conflict-free, and they violate the N5 direction rule

reading.note: NW moves the region INTO the crowded quadrant (N5 VIOLATED), so it is not an admissible answer

element_2_proven_facts.claim: the conflicts are not a routing-capability failure

reading.engine_state: true-shape obstacles (segments / oriented rects / circles) + fail-closed exact re-check; exam A attempt 7 reconnects 14 of 23 joints
reading.note: the remaining blocked joints include ports/targets that lie inside fixed foreign copper; no router can fix that, because the PLAN put them there

element_3_corrected_frame_and_delta.status: NOT APPLICABLE TO THIS SCENARIO - a correction would change the frozen members/frame/delta and therefore requires a NEW EXAM NUMBER (#K2-371 sec.2: 禁原地挪靶)

proposal_for_the_next_exam_issue.change: allow the CONFLICTING neighbours into the change set (the block's member set grows)
proposal_for_the_next_exam_issue.conservation: capacity: the moved set must have zero clearance conflicts against the fixed set => demand = the conflicting neighbour nets must be re-routable; measured: the conflicting pairs are few and named (PERSTA#/MCU_VDD, GND/PERSTA#, I2C1_SCL/I2C1_SDA, MCU_VDD/GND per direction/k)

proposal_for_the_next_exam_issue.change: use a delta that is conflict-free but rule-inadmissible (NW k=1..3), i.e. relax N5
proposal_for_the_next_exam_issue.conservation: capacity: conflict-free by measurement (3/64); demand: N5 direction rule must be waived by the adjudicator

proposal_for_the_next_exam_issue.change: keep the frame but forbid the rigid-translation family (require relative rearrangement inside the block)
proposal_for_the_next_exam_issue.conservation: demand: the in-block copper must then be re-laid, not translated; capacity: the block area must host the re-laid copper - not measured yet

element_4_buildability.meaning: the relocation cannot be built from the frozen drawing: the drawing itself (frame + delta) must be corrected first, and that correction is an adjudicator item because the scenario is frozen.
